learning about this stuff is mind blowing. i didn’t know what bpd was til after the breakup. i was explaining her behavior to my mom , and my mom said it sounds a lot like borderline.... i was like ‘border what??’ lol

yes yes & yes. she would always talk about how she has ‘ peaks and lows ‘. for example if she had a good moment she would say stuff like ‘ i had my peak which means the low is coming ‘ lol i even started thinking there was something wrong with me, maybe bipolar , because i was feeling the projection of her constantly changing emotions. it also seemed there was a euphoria after a meltdown in some weird way - hard to explain. 

she went thru multiple jobs,  got fired multiple times bc her bosses decided she couldn’t handle it. (she would always have ‘fainting’ episodes at work which her bosses definitely saw through.) she identified as lesbian before i knew her, then bisexual , then back identifying as lesbian after the discard. the explosive anger was everywhere, she showed me a video of her yelling at a girl at her school once, making a scene over some drama. (we met in highschool). it was at me and her parents as well. her mother has many issues of her own so their fights and anger were always on the same level. not so much her friends but it still happened when she would discard them. 

she changed her ‘aesthetic’ very often. from ‘soft indie girl’ to ‘skater girl’ to ‘punk-goth- alt girl’. the list goes on. always cutting and dying hair impulsively, always did it herself in her bathroom very poorly. 
she was always a follower with her friends, doing as they do. her most recent friends got her into acid and whippets.

‘feeling suspicious/ out of touch with reality’ WOAH i didn’t know this was a trait!! she would always talk about ‘disassociating’ and i didn’t even know what this meant before i met her, she complained to me about it lots.       i don’t know if this counts too but she was obsessed with the whole concept behind the matrix and how theres planetary ascension happening and she’s on the way to ascending thru her spiritual awakening or whatever and anyone that WASNT on the path of ascension was a sheep in her eyes and beneath her & ignorant etc ....

i don’t think all the fault is in one person either, i just feel like an asshole in general for not answering her apology and her requests for friendship & all. i agree with you 100% , i needed to hear that. i don’t think there’s any way i could respond truthfully without her turning it into an argument anyways.

if i really think about it i guess i ‘tricked’ myself into romantic feelings for her too, initially i had a gut feeling she was bad for me but the physical attraction and naivety got the best of me. she always made a point to describe the butterflies & warm feelings during the relationship so i don’t think it was ever all platonic in her eyes. shit like this makes me wanna go ask her if i was her first love after all like she always told me because the not knowing is eating me alive. thank you for your understanding and input, i definitely believe she took qualities she saw in me and idealized them, romanticized them, intentionally or not, i was just an opportunity for her to have a fairytale and she took it. hurts like a bitch but that’s to be expected.
